newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy store closed due to water damage.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy store closed due to water damage.

text.p: Best Buy Co Inc said Monday its store at 445 Howe Avenue in Akron, Ohio, was temporarily closed for clean-up and repairs due to water damage.

Best Buy said the store was damaged when a water sprinkler pipe burst at a neighboring retailer's store. The damage included a six-by-eight foot hole in the wall directly above the customer service area.
There were no serious injuries. The dollar amount of the damage not known, Best Buy said.
"We're working on reopening the store as quickly as we can," Heidi Geller, a Best Buy spokeswoman said.
